intro: Your mother asks about your weekend plans. Tell her what you want to do.

conversation.speaker: mother
conversation.text: The weekend is coming. What would you like to do?

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Say what you would like to do at the weekend.
expected: I would like to visit the park.
I want to play with my friends.
I would like to read a book.
conversation.hint: Try: "I would like to visit the park."

conversation.speaker: mother
conversation.text: That sounds nice. Why do you want to do that?

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Give a reason using the word because.
expected: Because I like it very much.
Because my friends will be there.

conversation.speaker: mother
conversation.text: All right. Shall we go in the morning or in the evening?

conversation.speaker: mother
conversation.text: Good. Who would you like to take with us?

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Say who you want to bring.
expected: I want to take my friend.
I would like to bring my brother.
conversation.hint: Try: "I want to take my friend."

conversation.speaker: mother
conversation.text: Then it is decided. It will be a lovely weekend.

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Say that you are excited about it.
expected: I am looking forward to it.
